values.name: Use of Singleton Pattern Without Synchronization in a Multithreaded Context

evidence.explanation: Spring singleton controllers/service contain final collaborators/configuration and static final logging/constants, not shared mutable request state. ImageReader, byte arrays and UploadResult are per-invocation locals (PhotoServiceImpl:36-46,81-143). Singleton scope alone is not a vulnerability.

values.description: The product uses the singleton pattern when creating a resource within a multithreaded environment.

values.name: Unsynchronized Access to Shared Data in a Multithreaded Context

evidence.explanation: No mutable static application fields or shared in-memory photo collection. Request response maps and upload state are method-local; JPA entity access is transaction-scoped.

values.description: The product does not properly synchronize shared data, such as static variables across threads, which can lead to undefined behavior and unpredictable data changes.

values.name: Improper Synchronization

evidence.explanation: No application-managed shared stream, cache, counter or exclusive mutable resource accessed concurrently. Photo writes/deletes use transaction-managed JPA; no security-sensitive read-modify-write invariant confirmed.

values.description: The product utilizes multiple threads or processes to allow temporary access to a shared resource that can only be exclusive to one process at a time, but it does not properly synchronize these actions, which might cause simultaneous accesses of this resource by multiple threads or processes.

values.name: Improper Locking

evidence.explanation: No manual synchronized blocks, explicit Lock/Semaphore acquisition, or filesystem locks in application code; therefore no unmatched lock release or incorrect lock ownership found.

values.description: The product does not properly acquire or release a lock on a resource, leading to unexpected resource state changes and behaviors.

values.name: Missing Synchronization

evidence.explanation: Service per-call image processing uses a new local ImageReader/stream, and repository writes occur inside @Transactional service methods. Concurrent duplicate deletion can affect an operation result but no authorization, balance, quota or other security invariant depends on exclusivity.

values.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner but does not attempt to synchronize access to the resource.

values.name: Incorrect Synchronization

evidence.explanation: No incorrectly scoped monitors, inconsistent lock objects or unsafe publication patterns. Spring constructor injection publishes final dependencies; no application-created background threads or executor tasks.

values.description: The product utilizes a shared resource in a concurrent manner, but it does not correctly synchronize access to the resource.
